# WO-224: Spanish translator handoff guide
Status: open (GO in CLAUDE-056)
Vendor: codex
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.4 (prep for Spanish UI in v0.5)
Agent: Nora Bennett's channel session (Amara). One WO = one session.
Source: CP-49 (docs/vendor/CODEX_PROPOSALS.md), accepted as proposed

## Goal / acceptance criteria
As in CP-49: a new `docs/i18n/TRANSLATION_GUIDE.md` explaining how translators use `STRINGS.md` and `GLOSSARY_ES.md`; preserve placeholders, plural/count meaning, possible-match uncertainty, practice-mode search behavior (it still searches; only removal requests are held), per-site scope and consent qualifiers; mark legal/consent and credential/security copy for in-house review; require native-speaker and product-owner review before adoption. Say plainly that the Spanish interface is not shipped. No translations, no edits to STRINGS.md or GLOSSARY_ES.md. Any file:line citations in the guide must point at real files and lines.

## Allowed paths
- `docs/i18n/TRANSLATION_GUIDE.md` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests -k "i18n or doc"`
